card.name: Truncation marks and URL breaks
card.fires_on: Marks where text is cut or broken, such as an ellipsis before a [more] link, a slash inside a shortened URL, or a split inside a number or word. It appears mostly in scraped web pages.

modes.label: Ellipsis cut-offs
modes.description: An ellipsis marks truncated preview text, often just before a [more] or read-more link.

modes.label: Inside URLs
modes.description: A slash within a shortened web address.

modes.label: Split numbers or words
modes.description: A digit or letter piece in the middle of a number, table cell, or hyphenated word.

card.plain: It fires where web text is cut short or broken up, such as at an ellipsis, a link, or the middle of a number.
